why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 ("README.md has a section for padLeft") should FAIL because a build that adds only a padLeft section leaves slugify undocumented, while the request asks for a complete list. The output marks line 3 "FAIL". Its evidence says index.js exports capitalize, slugify and truncate, but the README "has sections only for capitalize and truncate, so slugify is missing". It adds that a build adding only a '## padLeft' section "meets this line, and the README still does not list every function". It proposes a missing line covering every exported function. The wrong_build makes the same point about slugify. So the only must_catch item is handled.
